nodes.name: config.py
nodes.summary: Configuration persistence layer for the ePaper firmware, providing a JSON-backed key/value store with section-based access, batch write coalescing, and convenience helpers for checking WiFi and weather readiness.

nodes.name: ConfigManager
nodes.summary: Manages reading and writing the device configuration JSON file, supporting lazy loading, batch writes via a context manager, sectioned get/set access, and weather-city storage.

nodes.name: _Batch
nodes.summary: Context manager returned by ConfigManager.batch() that defers file writes until the block exits, coalescing multiple set() calls into a single save.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements the Python context manager protocol (__enter__/__exit__) to batch-defer JSON flushes on MicroPython where flash writes are expensive.

nodes.name: web_server.py
nodes.summary: Browser-based HTTP configuration UI for the Pico W ePaper device, serving WiFi, time-zone, and weather-settings pages over an asyncio socket server with URL decoding, form parsing, and live WiFi scanning.

nodes.name: _url_decode
nodes.summary: Decodes a percent-encoded URL string (converting %XX hex escapes and '+' to space) for safe extraction of form field values submitted by the browser.

nodes.name: _page
nodes.summary: Renders the outer HTML page shell — doctype, head, nav bar with active-tab highlighting, and embedded CSS — wrapping any inner body content passed by the caller.

nodes.name: _wifi_page
nodes.summary: Generates the WiFi settings page HTML, listing scanned networks in a dropdown with the currently saved SSID pre-selected and including a JavaScript rescan button that fetches /scan without a page reload.

nodes.name: _time_page
nodes.summary: Generates the time/calendar settings page HTML with 12/24-hour radio buttons, week-start day selector, and a timezone offset dropdown populated from a static list of UTC offsets.

nodes.name: _weather_page
nodes.summary: Generates the weather settings page HTML allowing the user to enter an OpenWeather API key, pick a Taiwan city from the preloaded list, and choose Celsius or Fahrenheit display, with optional weather log output.

nodes.name: WebConfigServer
nodes.summary: Async HTTP server that handles all configuration routes (/wifi, /time, /weather, /done, /scan, /log), dispatching GET and POST requests to the appropriate page-rendering functions and persisting form submissions via ConfigManager.

nodes.name: wifi_manager.py
nodes.summary: WiFi connection manager for the Pico W, handling AP mode (captive-portal hosting), STA mode (connection, reconnection with timeout), RSSI-to-signal-level conversion, and network scanning.

nodes.name: rssi_to_level
nodes.summary: Converts a raw RSSI dBm value to a discrete signal-strength level (0–4) for display on the ePaper status bar.

nodes.name: WiFiManager
nodes.summary: Manages both AP and STA WLAN interfaces on the Pico W, exposing methods to start/stop the access point, connect/disconnect as a station, query connection status and IP, and scan for nearby networks.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the MicroPython `network` module directly; AP and STA interfaces are independent WLAN objects that can run concurrently on the Pico W CYW43 chip.
